reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is user-facing quota monitoring inside the DSH web interface: a compact panel/card that displays API account balance and usage windows with status colors, refresh intervals, and countdowns. Evidence in the README and package metadata shows it is an overlay-style DSH web plugin that consumes external service usage data through host-side fetch logic and presents it in a UI-oriented layout.

summaries.zh: dsh-quota-status 是一款 DSH Web 插件，用于在界面卡片中展示 DeepSeek、Kimi 与 ChatGPT 的额度余额与重置倒计时，实现多账户用量的快速监控。
summaries.en: dsh-quota-status is a DSH web plugin that shows DeepSeek, Kimi, and ChatGPT quota status in a compact card with remaining amounts and reset timers for quick usage monitoring.

capabilities: Fetches usage and balance data from external service endpoints for DeepSeek, Kimi, and ChatGPT subscription limits
Renders an in-app quota status panel with collapsible rows, progress visuals, and reset countdowns
Supports host-side retrieval of credentials and local auth file integration for usage queries
Persists simple display preferences and accepts profile configuration for refresh and threshold behavior
Provides a slot-based extension point for extra quota rows from other local plugins
